name: Workflow Timer Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for controlling Timer nodes through typed backend actions only.

wakeup.role: The Timer is the only source of wakeup messages; the Goal node never wakes agents. Configure the Timer and the backend dispatches wakeup messages when it fires to every connected agent: the magnetic group (dock-linked members) plus agents connected by an ordinary edge with an event or control relation.
wakeup.readOnNextTurn: When a timer fires, a wakeup message with type 'wakeup' appears in your inbox; read it on your next turn. The message carries timerNodeId, scheduledAt, firedAt, and goalNodeId when the group has a Goal node.
wakeup.goalCheck: When the wakeup message references a Goal node, check the Goal state and tick its items before continuing.

internalActions.timer.fire: backend-internal; agents must never invoke it.
internalActions.timer.tick: backend-internal; agents must never invoke it.
internalActions.timer.dispatchWakeup: backend-internal; agents must never invoke it.

controlSurface.storage: Harness/a2a/event-nodes/**/state.json is backend-owned diagnostic storage, never an Agent control surface.
controlSurface.connectionRequirement: Agent-authored Timer control requires an Agent -> Timer relation=control edge. Timer -> Agent relation=event only delivers events.

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never invoke timer.fire, timer.tick, or timer.dispatchWakeup; they are backend-internal and rejected for agents.
Never edit event-node state files or the workflow map file.
Never invent timer actions that the backend does not expose.
